rationale: The Latin anchors abjicere, dejicere, projicere, ejicere (all meaning "to throw/cast away/down/out") point squarely to the core sense of propelling or casting something forcefully, matching throw.v.01 ("propel through the air"). While the extended senses (reprobare, repudiare = "to reject/repudiate") suggest a secondary metaphorical meaning, the primary and most frequent Latin glosses confirm the literal casting/throwing sense as the best single synset match.
